title: Auditable Authorization for LLM Agents: Empirical Evidence Across Model, Harness, and Workflow Layers
abstract: arXiv:2611.19237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human approval provides effective control only if rejected work stops and authorized work completes. We formalize refusal safety and bounded authorization completeness, and audit three execution boundaries: the model selects a call, the harness schedules and resumes it, and the workflow routes the decision to a protected effect. Paired decisions, exact traces, and native business-state witnesses support experiments with three models, five prompt arms, four runtime approval designs, two additional framework replays, and 100 public workflow sources.   The paired model panel leaves seven of 300 approvals unfinished despite zero denied effects; parallel confirmation loses an approved branch in three tasks per model, restoration omits 336/672 CrewAI approvals, and four of 59 comparable n8n workflows execute after Reject. translated_title: 面向LLM智能体的可审计授权：跨模型、执行框架与工作流层面的实证证据
translated_abstract: 人类审批只有在被拒绝的工作停止且已授权的工作得以完成时才能提供有效控制。我们形式化了“拒绝安全性”与“有界授权完整性”两个属性，并对三个执行边界进行审计：模型选择调用、执行框架调度并恢复该调用、以及工作流将决策路由至受保护的效果。基于配对决策、精确轨迹和原生业务状态见证，实验涵盖了三个模型、五种提示方案、四种运行时审批设计、两次额外的框架重放以及100个公开工作流来源。结果显示：在配对模型面板中，尽管没有出现任何被拒绝的效果，300个审批中仍有7个未完成；并行确认在每个模型的三个任务中丢失了已批准的分支；恢复机制遗漏了CrewAI全部672个审批中的336个；59个可比较的n8n工作流中有4个在“拒绝”之后仍然执行。通过对比意图、生成的调用、调度分发与原生效果，可以定位首个可观测的分歧点及其修复目标。
tldr: 该论文形式化了LLM智能体授权中的“拒绝安全性”与“有界授权完整性”，并在模型、执行框架与工作流三个层面的实证审计中揭示了大量授权失效问题——包括审批未完成、已批准分支丢失以及拒绝后仍执行等。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes refusal safety and bounded authorization completeness for LLM agent authorization, and its empirical audits across the model, harness, and workflow layers reveal widespread approval failures such as unfinished approvals, lost approved branches, and effects executing even after rejection.
